name: Beach Ball
summary: Inflated glossy vinyl beach ball with six bright gore panels, white end caps and a small valve plug.
description: Inflated glossy vinyl beach ball with six bright gore panels, white end caps and a small valve plug.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Editable sphere with exactly six 60-degree coloured gore regions and two disconnected white polar caps. Gore boundary vertices are recessed 1.5 mm to represent shallow vinyl welds; the adjoining faces slope into these channels. A flattened white valve plug sits in the upper cap. Glossy nonmetal vinyl with clear coat; no images or external assets.

display.origin: Floor contact point under the ball centre.

accuracy_notes: Inflation is represented as a spherical static shell. Welds taper into the end caps and use a simplified recessed strip instead of layered film. The valve is a small geometric plug without hinge, bore or inflation simulation. Panel colours are generic; slight extent differences follow weld recesses and the plug.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, materials and analytical texture bakes; no external models, fonts, images or logos.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
